description: Reads the phone numbers from Cosend (bought through Cosend for WhatsApp) in one of two views. held: the numbers this workspace holds now or gave back in the last 12 months, with how many count toward the plan’s limit. Each has its id (cnm_…), its status (buying, verifying while WhatsApp’s code is awaited, ready, stopping until its last day in release_at, released), and whether WhatsApp pre-verified it; when it did not, preverify_error says why and preverify_retry_at says from when Cosend may ask WhatsApp for a new code on the same number. available: up to 10 local US or Canadian numbers that can be bought now, each with its phone_number, country, locality and region, which a purchase names exactly; owners and admins only. Read-only.

area_code.description: For view available: a three-digit area code.

contains.description: For view available: 2 to 7 digits the number should contain.

country.description: For view available: US or CA.

view.description: held for the numbers this workspace has from Cosend; available for local numbers Cosend can get for it now, by country, area code and digits.

name: list_cosend_numbers
title: List phone numbers from Cosend
